messages:
alex: Hey team — opening a quota + capacity reservation request for an upcoming perf run. Can we sync on counts and cross-subscription capacity? Need approval/ETA by EOD tomorrow.

alex: Summary: target region = eastus2, window = 2025-05-12 → 2025-05-26 (2 weeks). Workload = model eval + stress tests. Prefer dedicated ND40rs_v2 where possible, otherwise ND96asr_v4 fallbacks.

alex: Subscriptions / desired SKUs (initial ask):
- prod-ml-01 (sub: ****-1111): 12 x Standard_ND40rs_v2, 4 x Standard_NC24s_v3
- staging-ml-02 (sub: ****-2222): 4 x Standard_ND40rs_v2
- research-ttl (sub: ****-3333): 2 x Standard_ND40rs_v2 (burst only)

alex: Also hit a couple infra limits we should escalate: VNet NIC limit for the prod-ml-01 vnet (current quota 250) — we need 320. NSG ephemeral port rule cap sitting at 1024 rules; our autoscaler may create >1200 security associations.

maria: Thanks — do we need the ND40rs_v2 SKU specifically (A100 80GB)? or can we accept ND96asr_v4 variants if ND40rs isn't available?

alex: Prefer ND40rs_v2 for latency and driver maturity. ND96asr_v4 is acceptable as fallback for non-latency-sensitive shards. Marked in internal reqs.

joel: For the NIC limit — looks like the subscription is under legacy vnet quota. I can request quota increase but Azure often asks for justification and scale plan. Alex, can you paste the scaling plan (nodes per subnet, expected pod density)?

alex: pasted plan below:

```
- cluster type: inference-eval
- nodes per AZ: 8 (prod), 2 (staging)
- pods per node (max): 42
- expected total NICs (prod vnet): 320
- required NSG rules: dynamic per-deployment ~ 1.2k
```

alex: Created initial Azure SR: SR# 220-987654321 (quota request submitted for ND40rs_v2 + ND96asr_v4). Internal tracker: INFRA-4123.

infra-bot: Jira ticket INFRA-4123 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4123 (assignee: joel).

maria: Quick cost check — reserving 12 ND40rs_v2 for 2 weeks on-demand is ~70k USD estimate? Can we do spot or burst for some nodes to reduce cost?

ashley: If this is a time-boxed perf run, we should mix reserved + spot. Proposal: reserve 8 ND40rs_v2 in prod-ml-01, use 4 spot ND40rs_v2 and 4 ND96asr_v4 on staging. That reduces cost ~30%. Also ensure we set preemption-aware retry.

alex: Sounds good. Update: changed requested counts (resubmit) — prod-ml-01: 8 reserved ND40rs_v2 + 4 spot ND40rs_v2 + 4 NC24s_v3; staging-ml-02: 4 ND96asr_v4 (reserve optional); research-ttl: 2 spot ND40rs_v2. Resubmitted SR with justification.

joel: I filed the NIC/NSG increase request in the Azure portal, link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/RequestDetails/REQ-554433 (status: New). I included the scaling plan and workload diagram.

maria: Any risk of quota fragmentation across subscriptions? We should ask Azure to allow cross-subscription reservations or at least prioritise the prod-ml-01 subscription.

joel: Yup — Azure reservations are per-subscription. I added a note to SR to prioritize prod-ml-01 and to allow transfer windows if possible.

infra-bot: Azure SR 220-987654321 updated: "Quota increase for Standard_ND40rs_v2 pending review — initial response ETA 48h."

alex: Can someone run a quick smoke test once quota is approved? I can deploy a small job to validate driver versions, CUDA, and NVLINK on ND40rs_v2.

joel: I'll own smoke test. Plan: spin 2 nodes, run `nvidia-smi`, run quick large-batch infer, confirm KV cache behavior. Command snippet I will run:

```
az vm list-usage -l eastus2 --query "[?name.value=='Standard_ND40rs_v2']"
az vm create --name smoke-nd40-1 --image UbuntuLTS --size Standard_ND40rs_v2 --subscription <prod-ml-01>
ssh azureuser@<ip> "nvidia-smi && ./run_smoke_infer.sh --model gpt-13b --batch 8 --seq 2048"
```

maria: Thanks joel. Can you also confirm that the autoscaler doesn't exceed the new NIC quota? Add guardrails in the cluster autoscaler config.

joel: Will do — adding `maxNodesPerSubnet` and NIC-aware thresholds.

alex: FYI I pinged account manager to prioritize capacity reservations (email thread created). If Azure says no to reservation, we may fallback to cross-region eastus + eastus2 split.

jira-bot: Comment added to INFRA-4123: "Assigned to joel. SR# 220-987654321 linked. Action items: joel -> NSG/NIC request, alex -> finalize smoke test script, ashley -> cost plan for reserved+spot mix."

ashley: I'll produce a quick cost sheet and post it here by EOD.

alex: Thanks all — will follow up once SR moves to 'In Review'. :thumbsup:

joel: Noted. I'll update thread when SR status changes or smoke test completes.

infra-bot: SR# 220-987654321 status changed -> In Review (ETA 36h)."
